**Recommendation: CLEAR for S1–S3 on this pinned synthetic design.** All three previous Medium findings are closed; no new scoped findings or regressions were found. Advance to prerequisite planning only; this review grants no implementation approval or owner method acceptance.
Reviewed accepted commit `d3c697c375ed7dc880e55ab3cc2219577cd133a5`, git-resolved tree `689ed2757ca4eb413cd37dc4f0cfcbc2fa90ba14`; all seven writing SHA256 values match #489 ([hashes and evidence](artifacts/review-evidence.md)).
Starting main `06e87cbbf100895ffa77d391940f5876ee0d5423` / tree `3215ca516a6a4ac2cff6acb12b5fce927a98becd` adds three administrative changes with identical writing bytes. Author checkpoint `f86939a…` is unavailable locally and is not the reviewed identity.
Historical baseline remains `486030b461e57ca0f322a17a5b7853e83e9655e3` / `cf75cf6892de2f9410fa09ee2589dcba47d825a4`; original candidate remains `7435c05c4fd7ddbaafb6f5db9081ad5a4f5db427` / `555960a979f4bec474850a39bd9b284b7188496a`.

## Standards

**S1 CLOSED:** [input-pins.json:3](../benchmark/writing/input-pins.json#L3) now names the git-verified historical baseline. Only its two identity fields changed; all 62 protected hashes and 56 unique preparation-index pins (74 references) match baseline, original candidate, accepted candidate, main and worktree bytes.
Actual writing changes: README.md, controls.json, input-pins.json, review-corrections.json (new), verification.json and verify_method.py; method.json is unchanged. Other differences are administrative; protocol/index/status/input bytes are preserved. No additional documented Standards violation ([complete paths and checks](artifacts/snapshot.json)).

## Spec

**S2 CLOSED:** [verify_method.py:168](../benchmark/writing/verify_method.py#L168) enforces both frozen and preserved-original versions. Independently setting original/original_after to v0 with output/frozen at v1 reproduces both old false acceptances; both now reject `version-drift`. Adjacent v2 probes distinguish both guards, reject absent/unknown originals and retain consistent modification, source-only rebuild and creation positives.
**S3 CLOSED:** [verify_method.py:204](../benchmark/writing/verify_method.py#L204) requires request, originals, allowed_inputs, model, budgets, key_revision and repetitions, independently derived from original protocol:79–84, runner and writing contracts. Removing each from frozen and both arms reproduces seven old false acceptances; corrected checks reject `pair-setting-required`. Frozen-only and either-arm omissions, mismatches and arm/accounting violations also reject ([exact mutations/reasons](artifacts/replay.json)).
`python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py` passes: all 35 original controls retain identical raw JSON objects, nine additions reject, five positives pass, and output/hash records match. Independent replay passes 75 probes (71 rejections, four adjacent positives), plus the original 35 rejections and five positives from original git bytes.
An isolated subprocess from `/` with environment={} produces identical stdout while an independent audit hook denies session access, writes, filesystem mutation, network and subprocesses; no LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT is needed ([replay](artifacts/replay.py), [results](artifacts/replay.json)).
Original #481 requirements remain covered: independent expected-result rules, preservation, creation/modification/source-rebuild tasks, separate artifact/answer/grounding/native dimensions, paired accounting and explicit coverage gaps. **Zero native executions and zero agent runs**; synthetic consistency establishes neither native validation, readiness nor product quality.

## What next

The next shaper can retain S1–S3 as closed for these bytes and plan native capability/grants (#169), original versions/consumer maps, matching sources/build tools, independent native keys/checkers, restricted allocation and tested isolation, quota/precision decisions and all-version writing estimates. Owner method acceptance remains a later prerequisite to product writing implementation; none is requested here.
Resume from the saved [review evidence](artifacts/review-evidence.md), [snapshot](artifacts/snapshot.json) and [replay](artifacts/replay.json); re-pin if writing bytes change. Avoid repeating POC reverse engineering, corpus research or global gap maps. Only session outputs were written; parent commits.
